verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents opening pull requests (including per-commit PRs via `cafe stack submit`), comparing diffs, and leaving feedback alongside the code, with reviews treated as first-class objects in rulesets and the MCP read tools. The inline-comment and diff-comparison claims come only from a homepage marketing line, so the depth is thin. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on the diff view and inline/line-level review comment mechanics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a pull request, compare diffs, and leave inline review comments alongside the code
